name: Hypotrichosis-Intellectual Disability, Lopes Type
aliases: Hypotrichosis with Intellectual Disability Lopes Type

ethnicAssociations: Reported in Portuguese and Brazilian populations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Hypotrichosis-Intellectual Disability Lopes Type

criteria.description: Characteristic facial dysmorphic features including prominent forehead and broad nasal bridge
Mild skeletal anomalies such as clinodactyly or brachydactyly

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital hypotrichosis and intellectual disability with supportive clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may confirm diagnosis but is not always available

imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific mild cerebral atrophy
Skeletal X-rays may reveal mild digital anomalies
genetic: Mutations in the gene associated with Lopes type hypotrichosis-intellectual disability (exact gene not fully characterized)
other: Clinical diagnosis primarily based on phenotype

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of additional ectodermal abnormalities such as nail dystrophy

redFlags: Severe intellectual disability beyond mild to moderate range
Presence of seizures or congenital heart defects
references: Lopes et al., 1996. Hypotrichosis and intellectual disability: a new syndrome. American Journal of Medical Genetics.
Orphanet Report on Hypotrichosis-Intellectual Disability Lopes Type, 2023.
GeneReviews: Hypotrichosis and Intellectual Disability Syndromes, 2024.
